nodes.name: safe-arrival-and-preparation
nodes.exit_condition: Player arrives without hostile pressure and can deliberately choose to launch.

nodes.name: deliberate-expedition-launch
nodes.exit_condition: Accepted server-owned launch transitions the player from preparation into the operation.

nodes.name: operation-lifecycle
nodes.exit_condition: A run can start, progress, terminate, clean up, and create a fresh replay identity.

nodes.name: movement-exploration-route
nodes.exit_condition: A player can traverse the operation route without developer guidance, collision traps, or prolonged confusion.

nodes.name: combat-loop
nodes.exit_condition: Combat is responsive, readable, understandable, and satisfying enough to sustain the run.

nodes.name: authored-objectives
nodes.exit_condition: Required objectives progress authoritatively and guide the player through the operation.

nodes.name: enemy-pressure-and-elite
nodes.exit_condition: Enemy pressure escalates coherently and at least one elite question is readable and beatable.

nodes.name: boss-climax
nodes.exit_condition: Boss completion produces a readable terminal transition and reward opportunity.

nodes.name: run-reward-choice
nodes.exit_condition: The run offers at least one meaningful, server-authoritative reward decision.

nodes.name: durable-bank-equip-upgrade
nodes.exit_condition: A reward or progression result survives the run boundary and changes a subsequent run through canonical durable owners.

nodes.name: result-and-debrief
nodes.exit_condition: Success/failure is committed once and presented clearly to the player.

nodes.name: return-and-clean-replay
nodes.exit_condition: The player can leave the completed run, return safely, and start a fresh run with no stale run state.

nodes.name: 20-30-minute-player-experience
nodes.exit_condition: A normal player can complete a coherent 20-30 minute session and wants another run.
